text: Based on the US Food and Drug Administration Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS), signal mining of adverse drug events (AEs) caused by Botulinum Toxin Type A (BoNTA) was performed to explore its safety implications for the treatment of cerebral palsy (CP).
source_label: Signal mining of botulinum toxin type A adverse events based on FAERS database and its implications for the treatment of cerebral palsy
